definitions.applied: COMPLETE guidance linked to completed subsequent TRAIN capture or native applied receipt with exact referenced capture hashes; not inferred from publication.
definitions.finish_cohort: Response finished_unix within [cut, observed_through], regardless of request time.
definitions.native_observed: Native receipt separately joins the exact request/response and records its disposition; MISSING/SILENT do not imply guidance injection.
definitions.pending: No published response observed through cutoff, not a failure or implicit consumption.
definitions.published: Bound response file plus exact claim PUBLISHED response hash, publication time no later than observed_through.
definitions.request_cohort: Native parent reservation/submission timestamp within [cut, observed_through]; queue file mtime is an explicitly labelled fallback only when native timestamp is absent.
definitions.semantics: No functional-quality or retained-learning inference. No FINAL files/contents used.
